products.name: Postedly
products.description: Prepare letters, certified mail, fax, postcards and handwritten cards with private browser approval; track orders and reuse saved correspondence.
products.longDescription: Prepare a fax, letter, certified letter, postcard or handwritten card from Postedly’s live catalog. Reuse contacts and correspondence drafts you ask to save, review the exact document or message, recipient, options and total through a private browser link, then track an owned order or export its recorded delivery evidence. A person approves payment on Postedly before fulfillment. Quotes, drafts and uploads do not send or charge. Contacts last one year after saving; drafts last 30 days and referenced PDFs may expire sooner. Provider milestones are not independent proof of receipt.
products.authDescription: OAuth 2.1 / PKCE for connected owner resources.
products.bounds: Check postedly_services or the live catalog before quoting fax, letters, certified mail, postcards or handwritten cards; availability is determined by the current response. Check the product catalog for handwritten cards. Use the connected OAuth owner and the actual intended document: preserve provided PDF bytes unless changes were requested; finish and inspect every page of a newly requested letter before upload. Intentional forms and test documents remain valid when requested. Review every page of the final proof; card samples are not a rendered proof of the exact message. Uploading, quoting and opening private review do not approve, charge or send. Payment requires the user's explicit browser review. Report payment and fulfillment separately. The object beta uses a separate manual request and is not an automated document order.
defaultPrompts: Prepare a quote and private review link for mailing this finished PDF.
Help me choose a handwritten card and review the exact message.
Check whether my existing order was paid, sent and delivered.

Export only a reviewed, priced or final estimate as documented.
